en-US.fullDescription: HomeKeeper remembers every appliance so you don't have to. Ask what's on the home agenda and get a live briefing: overdue maintenance, tasks due soon, expiring warranties, and safety recalls pulled from the CPSC feed every morning. Say an appliance is acting up and HomeKeeper triages it — checking warranty status, maintenance history, and a knowledge base — then recommends the right next step. Photograph any nameplate and Bedrock vision builds the appliance record automatically, down to the serial number. Deterministic hot path under 500 ms; Bedrock judgment when it's needed. Every appliance remembered, every task on time.
en-US.shortDescription: Your home appliance butler: tracks maintenance, warranties, and recalls for every device.

tagline: Every appliance remembered. Every task on time.
